text:
Olivia: Quick check — I want to bump inference-statefulset from replicas: 2 -> 4 and tighten the rollout so maxUnavailable: 0 for a short canary window. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/inference/pull/542
Ken: ok with bump, curious about startupProbe timing. When we increased replicas last time we hit long startup times and the readiness probe delayed canary. Did you adjust initialDelaySeconds?
Olivia: I lowered initialDelaySeconds from 30 -> 10 for the container and reduced periodSeconds to 5. Snippet: ```yaml
readinessProbe:
  exec:
    command: ["/bin/check-ready"]
  initialDelaySeconds: 10
  periodSeconds: 5
  timeoutSeconds: 2
```
Ashwin: also check the env that triggers model warmup — if we spin 2 extra pods we might double the DB connection churn briefly. Added a small ramp script?
Olivia: yeah, added a WM_STARTUP_DELAY env and the pod entrypoint sleeps a randomized 0-30s to avoid thundering herd. PR updated.
Maria: heads up — TF plan shows a change to the secret rotation mapping for inference/kms-key. We switched to using customer-managed key path `projects/redwood-ops/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/inference` — CI flagged the secrets-sync job until IAM binding is applied.
deploy-bot: terraform plan: 1 to add, 2 to change, 0 to destroy. Changed resources: google_kms_crypto_key_binding (update), kubernetes_stateful_set.inference (update)
Ken: can we ensure the secrets-sync job has the new KMS path in the org role? If not the mounting sidecar fails with 403 and the pod crashloops.
Maria: I'm on it — will open a quick IAM PR against cloud infra. ETA 30m.
Olivia: thanks. One more: the STS uses rollingUpdate with partition=0 now. I set maxSurge: 1 and maxUnavailable: 0 so we create before delete. Yaml change: ```yaml
updateStrategy:
  type: RollingUpdate
  rollingUpdate:
    partition: 0
    maxSurge: 1
    maxUnavailable: 0
```
Ashwin: sgtm, that's safer for steady traffic. Are we ok with temporary extra GPU allocation for the surge? Budget alert?
Olivia: I checked cost: temporary surge of 1 GPU for ~10m per pod create. Should be within quota for the canary window.
Jordan: I'll watch the autoscaler dashboard during canary. Ping me when you start.
Ken: quick note for oncall — please add a probe tweak rollback snippet in the runbook in case readiness hangs. Something like: `kubectl patch sts inference --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"updateStrategy":{"rollingUpdate":{"maxUnavailable":1}}}}'`
Olivia: good call, added to the runbook.
Maria: IAM PR merged, secrets-sync CI green. You can trigger the rollout once PR is approved.
Olivia: PR updated, tests passed. @Jordan can you /approve when you have a sec?
Jordan: LGTM, approving now.
Olivia: starting canary at 03:00 UTC (tagging ops). Will monitor pod startup logs and recovery. If anything spikes I'll roll back to replicas:2 and partition: currentRevision via the statefulset partition patch.
Ken: thanks — stand by for any alerts. :thumbsup:
Olivia: closing out here, will post a short postmortem if we see regressions.
